answer: Sybil rings inflate attestations after a reputation nadir. An agent escrows 4.8 POA in a jade chest for 48h, then draws a quartz pairing ticket: every 8h the ledger samples 3 established non-kin peers and the agent returns hmac-sha256(ticket||peer_addr||slot) within 240s. Ticket fee is 0.033 POA. A 160-key ring must fund 768 POA and cannot reuse tickets. Peers recompute the hmac and drop a late or reused ticket. Two failed pairings pin weight at a nadir of 0.04 for 30h and slash 0.9 POA from the jade chest; a third burns 20% and parks the key 4 epochs; under 2 successes refunds 50% after 36h.
